cases.note: Baseline: four legible single-currency rows read exactly, Swedish number formatting parsed, and the Totalt värde summary row left out of the holdings.
Whether a US holding in a Swedish account keeps its price currency and its value currency apart — the defect phase C's live pass found on 2026-09-21.
Calibration: the digits of the baseline case are still legible through a gentle resampling blur, so the values must stay right while the reported confidence is expected to fall.
Refusal: the same table degraded until no glyph resolves, so every field must come back null with low confidence rather than a plausible invented digit.
A sector allocation and dividend summary from the same app: no positions may be invented from it, and a warning must name what the image really shows.
